title: Ferrero to revive Wonka candy brand with Netflix

title: Independent grocers make up nearly 40% of US food retail sales, report says
summary: An NGA analysis found that every $1 in indie grocery sales generates an additional 58 cents in supply chain and household spending nationwide.
